about: Every official Hermes skill, read by script from the docs' two pages, with what each is for in plain words. hhcontent, 10 Nov 2026. Built and checked by dev/checks/hhcontent-skills-list/build_skills_list.py; edit plain.py or the script, never this file. Readable list: content/skills-list-v1.md. Alike skills and the left-out list: content/skills-duplicates-v1.md.
why_its_own_file: content/helper-wants-v1.json holds the rows Helper speaks and is already queued for the Builder; this file adds per-skill fields without touching it. Join by name. The build refuses if the two lists differ.

fields.for: what it is for, plain, at most 14 words, passes the R rules; or exactly 'not clear from the docs', and then Helper shows only docs_words
fields.for_from: page = written using the skill's own page; line = from the catalog line only; unclear
fields.needs: what the first lines of its own page say it needs, plus the Platforms row of that page
fields.left_out: true: Helper answers a question about it with its don't-know line (his words, 10 Nov 19:30). Approved by him: not yet
fields.found_by: built-in only: want_row id, or things and actions, or none with the reason
fields.say: Said by Helper after 'It teaches Hermes to' in S1/S2 (content/helper-skill-lines-v1.md). Says no more than docs_words. null = Helper keeps the fixed sentence
fields.say_from: for = the 'for' with a small first letter; rewritten = changed so it says no more than docs_words or fits the line; fixed: reason
fields.say_judged: where the plain words were checked against docs_words by reading, not by rule: what was judged

left_out_criterion: A skill is left out when its purpose is to get around safety or security, or when it can do real harm to the person or to others in a beginner's hands.
pair_rule: Looked at only after the topics and the want rows found nothing, and only on a message the person typed. A skill is named when one of its things and one of its actions are both in the message as whole words. Two or more skills found: show them as picks, at most four. Never named out of nowhere.

alike_groups.differ: Both come from the same outside project. brag-slim is its one-file, smaller version.
alike_groups.helper: Name brag only. Mention brag-slim only if asked by name.

alike_groups.differ: Both make PowerPoint files. pptx-author's own page points to microsoft-office as the broader, built-in one.
alike_groups.helper: Name the built-in microsoft-office first. pptx-author only if asked by name.

alike_groups.differ: The skill is the written steps for using the built-in Computer Use tool, not a second way to do it.
alike_groups.helper: Say the tool, Computer Use. Do not name the skill as a separate thing.

also: built-in tools web_search and web_extract (want row w_web)
alike_groups.differ: Its own page: it overlaps with Hermes's own web search, is paid with a free tier, and is not to be preferred.
alike_groups.helper: Name the built-in web search. parallel-cli only if asked by name.

alike_groups.differ: rss-feeds reads a feed once, nothing to add. blogwatcher keeps a list of blogs with read and unread, needs its own app. watchers checks feeds, GitHub or data links on a timer.
alike_groups.helper: Ask one question: once, or keep watching? Once: rss-feeds. Keep watching: blogwatcher and watchers.

also: Hermes itself writes and runs code (want row w_code)
alike_groups.differ: Each hands a coding job to a different outside coding app: Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, OpenCode, OpenHands, Blackbox, Antigravity.
alike_groups.helper: Say first that Hermes codes by itself. Name an outside app only when the person names it or says they use it.

alike_groups.differ: meeting-action-items works on meeting notes from anywhere. document-to-action-items on contracts, reports and forms. teams-meeting-pipeline fetches Teams meetings first.
alike_groups.helper: Pick by the thing named: meeting, document, or Teams. One name each time.

also: Hermes's own Email messaging, where people email Hermes (himalaya's page says it is separate)
alike_groups.differ: himalaya opens any mailbox. google-workspace is Gmail and the rest of Google. email-inbox-triage sorts an inbox through one of those two. agentmail gives Hermes its own new inbox.
alike_groups.helper: Ask one question: Gmail or another mailbox? Gmail: google-workspace. Other: himalaya. Name email-inbox-triage only for sorting. agentmail only if asked by name.

also: topic svc (Gmail and other services), whose key words include gmail, google calendar, drive, sheets
alike_groups.differ: The topic answers "use Gmail or Calendar" with its own line. The skill is how Hermes does it.
alike_groups.helper: The topic speaks first. Its line or paste text may name google-workspace as the built-in skill. Not checked whether svc1's words already do.

also: topic svc, whose key words include github, obsidian, youtube
alike_groups.differ: The topic catches these names before any skill is looked at, so the skill is never named by key words.
alike_groups.helper: Add the skill's name to the topic's line for that service, or let the skill row win for these three names. hhcontent's next pass.

alike_groups.differ: architecture-diagram: one dark picture of a system. archify: clickable diagram, kept up elsewhere. system-atlas: a 3D-style clickable map. excalidraw: hand-drawn look. concept-diagrams: teaching drawings, not software.
alike_groups.helper: Name the built-in architecture-diagram for software. Name concept-diagrams for school topics. The rest only if asked by name.

alike_groups.differ: humanizer removes signs of AI writing. simple-english rewrites in very simple English and its page says it removes those signs as a side effect.
alike_groups.helper: Name the built-in humanizer. simple-english when the person wants simpler words.

alike_groups.differ: requesting-code-review checks new code for safety and errors before saving. simplify-code tidies code that already works.
alike_groups.helper: Pick by the word: check or review, then the first. Tidy or simplify, then the second.

alike_groups.differ: claude-design: a one-off page or deck. sketch: two or three quick drafts to compare. popular-web-designs: copy a famous site's look. auteur, scrollcraft: showy pages. impeccable: advice, kept up elsewhere. design-md: a file describing a look.
alike_groups.helper: Name the two built-in ones, claude-design and popular-web-designs. The rest only if asked by name.

alike_groups.differ: publish-site: on the person's own GitHub, Cloudflare or Netlify. cloudflare-temporary-deploy: one hour, no account. here-now: on here.now.
alike_groups.helper: Ask one question: for an hour, or to stay? Hour: cloudflare-temporary-deploy. Stay: publish-site.

alike_groups.differ: comfyui and inference-sh-cli make any picture with an outside app. The rest each make one kind: memes, pixel art, posters, article pictures, mascot logos, infographics.
alike_groups.helper: Name the built-in picture tool first. A one-kind skill only when the person names that kind.

also: built-in tool video_generate, off at first (want row w_video)
alike_groups.differ: manim-video: maths explainers. ascii-video: letters. hyperframes: motion graphics from web pages. ai-presenter-video: a talking person. kanban-video-orchestrator: splits a big job. comfyui, inference-sh-cli: outside apps. brag: launch videos.
alike_groups.helper: Ask one question: what kind of video? Then one name. The built-in video tool for plain text-to-video.

alike_groups.differ: songwriting-and-ai-music helps write a song and the text for Suno, a paid music website. heartmula makes the song itself on the person's computer.
alike_groups.helper: Name the built-in one first. heartmula when they want the music made on their own computer.

alike_groups.differ: Each works with a different notes app or folder. llm-wiki builds new linked notes. qmd searches notes already there.
alike_groups.helper: Pick by the app the person names. With no app named, ask which notes app they use.

also: topic mod (Which AI to use), where a model on your own computer is one answer
alike_groups.differ: All run an AI model on the person's own machine. llama-cpp on an ordinary computer. vLLM and TensorRT-LLM need strong graphics cards.
alike_groups.helper: The Model topic speaks first. Name llama-cpp only if asked how to run a model on their own computer.

alike_groups.differ: All are for training AI models. They differ in method and scale, which the pages explain in terms a newcomer will not know.
alike_groups.helper: Do not name these unless asked by name. Then show only the docs' words.

alike_groups.differ: The skill lets the person's own Hermes answer questions about Hermes. Helper does the same from checked lines.
alike_groups.helper: Nothing. Worth knowing: the paste boxes already send the person to their own Hermes, which has this skill.

borderline_not_marked.blocked-page-recovery: Built in. Gets a copy of a page that blocks you, paywalls too. It fetches copies, it does not break in.

borderline_not_marked.stripe-link-cli: Spends real money. Every payment must be approved by the person in the Link app.
borderline_not_marked.telephony: Buys phone numbers and makes AI phone calls to real people. Paid.
borderline_not_marked.pinggy-tunnel: Opens something on the person's computer to the whole internet for a while.
